summary: The md5 filter returns an MD5 hash of the input; MD5 may be unavailable under FIPS and is insecure for security uses.
questions: How do I get an MD5 hash in Ansible?
Why does the md5 filter fail on a FIPS system?
Is MD5 safe for password hashing?

answer_card.title: md5 filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ data | md5 }}` returns the MD5 hash. It requires MD5 to be available, which security contexts like **FIPS** may prevent. MD5 is insecure and not recommended for security-related uses.
